kicker: LEDGER · Thursday 22 October · the street, the shop family's sample
title: Rita's front in the street
how: Shortfalls first. At night her window's light burns the display's pale side wall, the big white vase and the china jug to pure white (set aside after two tries; next, the strip lights under the shelves the cloud designed). The front is clean, with no wear yet; the goods stand in tidy rows rather than a crammed 1990 window; the watches and clocks have no glass; PAWNBROKER under her name and the words on the glass do not read from the hook camera. The lamp columns: darker and grimed at the foot as you asked, but the rain staining read as an even grain after two tries and is set aside, so they are not done.

The cloud's whole front for Rita's pawnbroker now stands in the street behind the street's own glass (so the broken-window crime still works on it): the fascia with RITA'S, the three gilt balls on their bracket, the doors, the 3D display of goods on velvet tiers and her room behind. Each view passed one fresh reviewer or carries its set-aside; the reviews found the balls hung across their bracket (seen as two from along the street) and the window light burning the joinery, both fixed. Taken today in the game at 2560 by 1440, shown at full size.
foot: Nothing bought or signed up for. Anything you do not pick carries onto the next page.
